cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 18 since November 2018. He owns Kiel Equipment, an equipment rental company he started in 1996, and has been a managing partner of SAL Properties since 2013. He is vice chair of the House Ways and Means Education Committee.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Kiel was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no documented stance of his on data centers, development or growth limits. We also found no record of actions or stated positions on homestead taxes, foreign or investor land buying, immigration or H-1B, police pay, school choice or teacher pay. His campaign site and Ballotpedia survey give only general lines such as smaller government, less taxes and fiscal responsibility. No controversies, foreign ties or endorsements turned up in the pages reviewed. His bills sponsored are not listed in the pages we had, and we found no record of his actions on the listed issues.

qual.background: He has served in the Alabama House since 2018, and has owned Kiel Equipment, an equipment rental company, since 1996. He has also been a managing partner at SAL Properties, a property management firm, since 2013.
qual.why: Scored in the high band for roughly eight years of prior legislative service, together with more than 25 years running a business. His committee posts, including vice chair of Ways and Means Education, were not counted. No law, policy-staff or budget career is documented.
